adjudication: Pricing preference depends on whether users perceive durable ongoing value beyond the timer. Keep business-model decisions separate from core product architecture and test willingness to pay after the differentiated coach loop is demonstrated.
claim_topic: Whether a premium focus app should use subscription pricing
notes: Next wave should compare competitor pricing, app-store reviews, and possible open-source or local-first positioning.

positions.label: subscription-supporting
positions.summary: Competitor subscriptions bundle ongoing sync, blocking, integrations, analytics, and updates.

positions.label: subscription-resistant
positions.summary: Some Mac community participants reject recurring prices for a focus timer and prefer simple physical tools or one-time purchases.

residual_uncertainty: No representative willingness-to-pay data has been gathered.

adjudication: The evidence does not justify one compulsory cadence. Product design should offer distinct timing policies, preserve user control, and evaluate outcomes within the user's task and energy context.
claim_topic: Whether fixed systematic Pomodoro breaks are superior to self-regulated or Flowtime breaks

positions.label: systematic-breaks
positions.summary: The 2023 experiment associated systematic breaks with less fatigue and distraction and more concentration and motivation than self-regulated breaks.

positions.label: flexible-breaks
positions.summary: Later studies found either costs for rigid Pomodoro timing or more positive subjective states under self-regulated breaks.

residual_uncertainty: Evidence is primarily student-based and not ADHD-specific; no robust trial validates an adaptive algorithm for this product.

adjudication: Use maximal craft, not maximal glass coverage. Concentrate refraction and morphing in navigation and controls; use tactile, dimensional, high-fidelity standard-material content surfaces and an ambient Metal field for richness.
claim_topic: Whether an extremely advanced interface should apply Liquid Glass throughout the product
notes: This preserves the requested non-minimal identity while following the platform hierarchy.

positions.label: maximal-glass
positions.summary: The product direction asks for an unmistakably rich Liquid Glass and skeuomorphic visual identity.

positions.label: selective-glass
positions.summary: Apple recommends Liquid Glass as a sparse functional layer and warns against using it throughout content.

residual_uncertainty: The exact visual intensity and acceptable motion budget require mockups, accessibility variants, and performance prototypes.
